title: react33.config — react33Styles, react33I18n, react33Theme, react33Networking, react33Session
description: Root schema for react33.config.json. Published by @react33/react-config. Optional $schema key, or associate via .vscode/settings.json (json.schemas).

$schema.description: Opcional si el editor ya asocia react33.config.json vía workspace (ver @react33/react-config). Si lo declarás: ./node_modules/@react33/react-config/react33.config.schema.json

react33Networking.description: Generated API registry and client hooks (@react33/react-networking). Convention: *Output paths are relative to react33.config.json; *Module specifiers are relative to the generated file they are emitted into.

registryOutput.description: Path for the generated API registry module (apis.generated.ts — createApiRegistry, apis, *Request). Write path — relative to react33.config.json. Overrides CLI default when --output is omitted.

hooksOutput.description: Optional path for the generated client hooks module. Write path — relative to react33.config.json. If omitted, derived from registryOutput (e.g. apis.client.generated.tsx next to apis.generated.ts).

runtimeModule.description: Optional module specifier emitted verbatim into an import of the generated registry module — relative to that GENERATED FILE (registryOutput), no extension. Must export `apiRuntime: ApiRuntime` (all fields optional): `defineDefinitions?`, `load?`/`loads?`, `defaults?`/`defaultsByApi?`. Single seam between codegen and app-level wiring. Typically points at the framework-agnostic file generated from `react33Session` (`react33Session.runtimeOutput`, e.g. `./session.runtime.generated`) — that file is server-safe and supplies `loads`/`defaultsByApi`. See `@react33/react-networking` ApiRuntime type.

apis.description: Map of API name -> { url, headers?, cache?, credentials?, session? }. `session` is the name of a `react33Session.sessions` entry that authenticates this API (the api→session foreign key); omit for an unauthenticated API.

react33OpenApi.description: OpenAPI 3.1+ codegen (@react33/react-networking). Paths relative to react33.config.json.

specSource.description: OpenAPI spec file the codegen reads. Read path — relative to react33.config.json.

client.description: HTTP client overrides when apis.<scope> is omitted (OpenAPI-first). url comes from servers[0] + basePath.

source.description: Init-data module the codegen reads. Read path — relative to react33.config.json.

validate.description: Runtime Zod validation for SDK params/response.

operations.description: Per operationId: fetchOnMount, verbose, initData, validate, security.

react33Persistence.description: Claves y modo de persistencia en browser compartidos por locale (react33I18n) y tema (react33Theme).

cookieName.description: Nombre de la cookie cuando el backend activo es cookie.

localStorageKey.description: Clave de localStorage cuando el backend activo es localStorage.

persistenceMode.description: Backend por defecto si la app soporta ambos.

persistenceEnvKey.description: Env var para sobreescribir persistenceMode (defaults: REACT33_I18N_PERSISTENCE / REACT33_THEME_PERSISTENCE). Debe exponerse al cliente: Vite envPrefix REACT33_; Next NEXT_PUBLIC_* + mismo nombre aquí. Ver docs/persistence-env-client.en.md. "" desactiva override.

allOf.description: Locale: convención de rutas y mensajes (ver @react33/react-i18n).

localesDir.description: Carpeta de módulos por idioma. Read path — relativo a react33.config.json.

urlLocalePattern.description: Regex (string) sobre pathname; primer grupo de captura = locale.

typesOutput.description: Ruta del módulo de tipos/constantes generado (p. ej. i18n.generated.ts). Write path — relativo a react33.config.json.

runtimeOutput.description: Ruta del runtime SPA generado (Provider, hooks, persistencia). Write path — relativo a react33.config.json.

allOf.description: Tema: opciones extra de escritura de cookie. defaultTheme suele venir de styles.meta generado.

cookieMaxAgeSeconds.description: Max-Age del cookie de tema (~1 año por defecto).

runtimeOutput.description: Ruta del runtime de tema generado (Provider, hooks, persistencia). Write path — relativo a react33.config.json.

stylesModule.description: Module specifier de styles.generated, emitido verbatim en un import del archivo runtime generado. Relativo al ARCHIVO GENERADO (runtimeOutput), sin extensión.

react33Styles.description: Paths are relative to the config file directory.

cssDir.description: Directory containing *.css source files. Read path — relative to react33.config.json.

domainsOrder.description: Cascade order (file stems without .css). Overrides alphabetical discovery.

stylesOutput.description: Output path for the generated styles module (styles.generated.ts). Write path — relative to react33.config.json.

excludeStems.description: Stems to skip when auto-discovering CSS files (ignored if domainsOrder is set).

banner.description: First line(s) of the generated TypeScript file.

verbose.description: Log resolved config, cssDir, domain order, and output path.

watch.description: Watch cssDir for changes and regenerate (same as CLI --watch). Use CLI --no-watch to force a one-off run when this is true.

metaSourceStem.description: Which CSS stem provides @theme meta (defaultTheme, cols). Default: tokens, else first domain.

react33Session.description: Session managers + UI runtime (@react33/react-session) as an indexed collection — one or more named sessions, each authenticating one or more APIs with its own token/auth. Mirrors the map-of-named-entries shape of `react33Networking.apis`. The codegen emits a framework-agnostic `session.runtime.generated.ts` (the managers + `apiRuntime`) plus a derived `.client.generated.ts` (`SessionProvider`/`useSession`). Paths are relative to react33.config.json.

runtimeOutput.description: Output path for the GENERATED framework-agnostic session module — the managers + `apiRuntime` (`loads`/`defaultsByApi`). Write path, relative to react33.config.json. Server-safe: no `'use client'`. Canonical suffix rule — `.generated.ts`. Recommended: `./src/api/session.runtime.generated.ts`. The client-side React module (`SessionProvider`/`useSession`) is written to a path DERIVED from this one by inserting `.client` before `.generated` (e.g. `session.runtime.client.generated.ts`). `react33Networking.runtimeModule` must point at THIS (agnostic) file.

primarySession.description: Name of the session (a key in `sessions`) that receives the React runtime — `SessionProvider` + `useSession`/`useSessionState` via `createSessionRuntime`. At most one session is primary. Omit for an app with no react33 React session surface (all sessions are pure `loads` token-holders, or the UI reads auth from a third-party hook such as `useAuth0`). Must reference an existing key in `sessions`.

sessions.description: Map of session name -> session definition. The key is the name referenced by `react33Networking.apis.<api>.session`. Always a map, even for a single session — consistent with `react33Networking.apis`.

react33SessionDef.description: One named session: a strategy + its un-serializable seam (`runtimeModule`) + strategy-specific static config. Each session produces one `LoadRequestProps` wired into `apiRuntime.loads` for every API that names it.

strategy.description: Session strategy. `bearer` — react33-managed access+refresh JWT (BearerSessionManager + createBearerSessionLoad). `bearer-static` — managed access token with NO refresh (BearerStaticSessionManager): react33 holds + decodes the token and exposes the snapshot + load, but a 401 is terminal (re-auth at the app level). `external` — the dev brings their own session (Firebase Auth, Auth0, Supabase, NextAuth, a token exchange, …): the `runtimeModule` seam exports a ready `load: LoadRequestProps` directly and the codegen skips manager construction. `cookie`/`opaque` — roadmap, not implemented. See packages/session/README.en.md "Strategies side by side".

runtimeModule.description: Module specifier emitted verbatim into an import of the generated session module — relative to that GENERATED FILE (react33Session.runtimeOutput), no extension. The un-serializable seam for this session. For `bearer`: exports `selectors: BearerSessionSelectors<Tokens>` + `refresh: (rt: string) => Promise<Tokens | null>`. For `bearer-static`: exports `selectors: BearerStaticSessionSelectors<Tokens>` (just `selectAccessToken`) — no `refresh`. For `external`: exports `load: LoadRequestProps` (always) and `sessionStore?: SessionStore<TSnapshot>` (only when this session is the `primarySession`). For `cookie`/`opaque`: `selectIdentity` + a `fetchMe` callable. Framework-agnostic by design (no React) — no `.client` suffix; e.g. `./main.session.runtime` resolves `main.session.runtime.ts`.

bearer.description: Settings consumed by `createBearerSessionManager` + `createBearerSessionLoad`. Ignored unless strategy === "bearer".

storageKey.description: sessionStorage/localStorage key where the refresh token is persisted. Same value that today lives hardcoded in your handwritten `createBearerSessionManager({ storageKey })`.

storage.description: Where the refresh token is persisted. `sessionStorage` (default): per-tab, no cross-tab sync. `localStorage`: persists across tabs and enables the cross-tab subscriber. The access token is always in memory regardless of this choice. See README → "Storage trade-offs".

accessTokenSkewSec.description: Seconds before the JWT `exp` claim to consider the access token expired. Used by `isAccessTokenExpired()` and (when proactiveRefresh is true) by the bridge before each request.

headers.description: Header template merged into each request by `createBearerSessionLoad`. The literal substring `{token}` is replaced with the current access token. Use for non-bearer schemes too — e.g. `{ "X-Api-Key": "{token}" }`.

proactiveRefresh.description: When true, the bridge calls `session.ensureFreshSession()` if the access token is expired AND a refresh token exists, BEFORE attaching the header to the request. Disable to refresh strictly reactively via `onRetry` on 401 — see README → "Why proactiveRefresh + onRetry is safe to combine".

bearerStatic.description: Settings consumed by `createBearerStaticSessionManager` + `createBearerStaticSessionLoad`. Ignored unless strategy === "bearer-static". Optional — all fields default; with `storage: "memory"` no config is needed at all.

storage.description: Where the access token is kept. `memory` (default): not persisted, lost on reload — right when a third-party SDK owns the real session. `sessionStorage`: persisted per-tab, survives reload. `localStorage`: persisted and synced across tabs.

storageKey.description: Storage key for the access token. Required unless `storage` is `"memory"`.

accessTokenSkewSec.description: Seconds before the JWT `exp` claim to consider the access token expired. Used by `isAccessTokenExpired()`.

headers.description: Header template merged into each request by `createBearerStaticSessionLoad`. The literal `{token}` is replaced with the current access token. Use for non-bearer schemes too — e.g. `{ "X-Api-Key": "{token}" }`.

cookie.description: Cookie-only session settings (planned, not implemented yet). Reserved here so apps can plan the migration when the strategy ships.

meEndpoint.description: Path where the client fetches the authenticated user profile (e.g. `/me`). Source of truth for `{ isAuthenticated, identity }` in the snapshot.

logoutEndpoint.description: Path the client POSTs to so the server can invalidate the HttpOnly cookie.

bootstrapOnMount.description: When true, the runtime calls `session.bootstrap()` once on mount so identity is hydrated before the first page render. Set to false if you orchestrate bootstrap manually (e.g. behind a login gate).

cache.description: Optional UX cache so the UI doesn't flash a skeleton on every navigation. The server still owns the truth — a stale cache is corrected by the next 401 → bootstrap reaction.

key.description: Storage key for the cached profile.

retry.description: Retry policy for the APIs this session authenticates. Emitted PER-API into `apiRuntime.defaultsByApi` (via the `createBearerSessionRetry` helper) so a 401 from one API refreshes only this session's token, never another's. Omit for proactive-only refresh (the `load` already refreshes an expired token before the request). Ignored unless strategy === "bearer".

statuses.description: Per-status retry budget — same shape as `RetryBudget` in @react33/react-networking. Example: `{ "401": 1 }` retries once on unauthorized after running `onRetry` (which by default calls `ensureFreshSession`).

tokenExpiredCode.description: Optional body-level error code that distinguishes "refresh eligible" from "revoked". When set, the generated `onRetry` only triggers a refresh if `response.data.code` matches this string or is undefined. Useful when the backend differentiates expired tokens from invalidated sessions.

persistenceEnvKey.description: Env var the build/runtime can read to override `bearer.storage` (or `cookie.cache.storage`). Same env-driven override pattern as `react33I18n.persistenceEnvKey` and `react33Theme.persistenceEnvKey`. Must reach the client — see docs/persistence-env-client.en.md. Empty string disables override.

then.description: Bearer strategy requires the `bearer` block (at minimum `storageKey`).
Cookie strategy requires the `cookie` block (at minimum `meEndpoint`).
